regions.today: A cloudy start this morning but staying mostly dry. Fresh southerly winds will continue through the afternoon as more cloud builds later. Rather mild to with highest temperatures of 18 to 21 degrees.
regions.tonight: A mix of cloud and clear spells but some light patchy rain will drift over at times too. Some mist patches forming too as winds fall light and lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Cloudy but dry before rain moves in from the west later in the morning. The rain will be heavy at times before clearing eastwards later in the afternoon. Fresh and gusty southerly winds change westerly. Highest temperatures of 14 to 18 degrees.
